editorial:
Imagine the pressure of a high-stakes race where your teammates are supposed to be your best friends, but they are actually your biggest rivals. You get to follow three different cyclists on Team Radiant who are all fighting for the top spot. You have Ming, who is way too cocky and only cares about his own fame, and Tian, a shy guy who just can't seem to get a break in life or love. Then there is Ji-won, who is caught in a tough spot between his loyalty to his manager and doing the right thing. It feels like a sports movie but with a lot of heart and some really intense drama that makes you root for them to finally get along.

What really works here are the racing scenes because they make you feel like you are right there on the bikes. The acting is solid, and watching the guys grow from rivals to actual friends is the best part. While the plot is a bit predictable, the energy keeps you glued to the screen. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final race, the three riders finally stop fighting and start working as a real team. Instead of trying to win for themselves, they use their skills to help each other move forward. They put aside their egos and sacrifice their own glory to make sure the team succeeds. This teamwork pays off as they cross the finish line together, proving that friendship and trust are more important than a single trophy.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves underdog stories and high-energy sports action.
